mentions.name: BootUp
mentions.description: This online course teaches how carbon dioxide removal works in a book-club style: participants are matched up with a group of people and talk through the topics together; thousands of people have taken it.
mentions.problem: Individuals lack clear ways to take action on carbon dioxide removal.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The other thing that comes to mind is we have a online course where thousands of people have got together and learned about how carbon dioxide removal works: https://bootup.airminers.com/

It's book club style, so you're matched up with a bunch of people and you get to talk through the topics together.
